## Before requesting review

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant documentation or examples.
- [ ] I recorded validation above and added a regression check for behavior changes, if applicable.
- [ ] Frozen acceptance tests and fixtures are unchanged; any new fixtures have provenance and license information.
